position_overview: As a freelance online French Language Trainer with Speexx , you'll be part of an international team that cares! You will be able to immediately make a difference in the lives of our adult learners who come from some of the biggest companies in the world by outfitting them with the tools they need to communicate effectively in the workplace. You will provide virtual 1:1 and group language training sessions via our platform and will be able to develop and broaden your teaching skills as opportunities arise within the Speexx global network. What You Bring to Speexx Can you answer "Yes!" to ALL of the following questions? Are you a proficient speaker (CEFR C2) of French? Have you earned an official accredited certificate to teach French? Do you currently teach online and have experience teaching adults in business contexts? Do you speak English at a CEFR B2 level or higher? (You will be asked to complete a level test to confirm your level) Do you speak Italian at any level? Have you earned a Bachelor's degree or higher? Do you meet the technical requirements (see below)? Payments: We can ONLY make payments to an IBAN account What Speexx Offers You Be part of an international team! Full integration into our global community of coaches, who care! Work from anywhere and whenever you want 24/7! 100% remote and 100% autonomy over your work schedule Full access to our trainer Academy with loads of professional development content Work made easy: Google Calendar integration allows you to sync the Speexx calendar with your other freelancing calendars! All teaching materials and content are provided Free language courses for you and discounts for family and friends! You will be able to immediately make a difference in the lives of our adult learners who come from some of the biggest companies in the world by outfitting them with the tools they need to communicate effectively in the workplace. You will provide virtual 1:1 and group language training sessions via our platform and will be able to develop and broaden your teaching skills as opportunities arise within the Speexx global network. What You Bring to Speexx Can you answer "Yes!" to ALL of the following questions? Are you a proficient speaker (CEFR C2) of French? Have you earned an official accredited certificate to teach French? Do you currently teach online and have experience teaching adults in business contexts? Do you speak English at a CEFR B2 level or higher? (You will be asked to complete a level test to confirm your level) Do you speak Italian at any level? Have you earned a Bachelor's degree or higher? Do you meet the technical requirements (see below)? Payments: We can ONLY make payments to an IBAN account What Speexx Offers You Be part of an international team! Full integration into our global community of coaches, who care! Work from anywhere and whenever you want 24/7! 100% remote and 100% autonomy over your work schedule Full access to our trainer Academy with loads of professional development content Work made easy: Google Calendar integration allows you to sync the Speexx calendar with your other freelancing calendars! All teaching materials and content are provided Free language courses for you and discounts for family and friends! See what you'll save https://shop.speexx.com/shop/ Paid initial and future training Paid and fair cancellation policies A variety of teaching services and/or pedagogical work to maximize your earnings Application Process Speexx gets back to all candidates who complete the Application Form Completing the Application Form should take approximately 15 minutes You will be asked to upload a C.V. and a cover letter You will be asked to verify that you are tax compliant in the country of your residence You will be asked to verify that you meet the Technical Specifications listed below As a final step on the Application Form, we ask you to provide us with a link to a 1-2 minute introductory video highlighting how your teaching efforts have made a difference in the professional lives of your students We at Speexx are looking forward to getting to know you! Technical Requirements To ensure both you and your clients/users will have an optimal online coaching experience, please check that your specifications meet the following requirements before continuing with your application. Thanks in advance! Computer random access memory (RAM): min 8 GB How to check RAM instructions Connect with Ethernet for best stability All about Ethernet Central processing unit (CPU): Multi-Core Score = minimum 1300 Connect with Ethernet. Download Geekbench v5 (free trial): Run the CPU test and the CPU benchmark tests Speed test: Download = min 30 mbps; Upload = min 10 mbps Connect with Ethernet. Go to Speedtest ,set server to Frankfurt am Main, run the test Speexx Real Time Communication tool (RTC): Compatibility RTC is the 100% GDPR compliant Speexx tool used to host online sessions, including your interview Connect with Ethernet: Go to Speexx RTC test. Test runs automatically and the result is visible at the top Age of equipment: MAC: Not older than 2018 / PC: Not older than 2020 iOS (Version 15.0 or later) Android (Version 8.0 and up) Chromebooks and tablets are not supported. Audio and visual equipment, coaches need to provide high-quality audio and video, preferably via an external webcam and an actively noise-cancelling, cabled headset Originally posted on Himalayas
